role: Confirmatory blind LoveDA Train GT evaluation of frozen OpenAI-CLIP text-only, visual-only, and 0.5/0.5 text+visual region recognition

blind.declaration: The LoveDA Train pixel GT is never opened before every region prediction is computed and persisted; the evaluate phase requires the predict-phase manifest and prediction artifact hashes, then reads GT only to score frozen predictions.
blind.split_by: original image_id, sha256(f'42:{image_id}') lexicographic ranking, first 1647 development images, remaining 411 heldout images; no image contributes regions to both prototype support and evaluation
blind.gt_use: region GT label derived by majority vote over the 6-class colors inside the SAM3 candidate mask of the heldout region; background and ignore pixels never vote

split_inputs.coverage: every frozen pixel-pack (image_id,candidate_index) key exactly once

model.identity: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 quick-GELU; OpenCLIP/timm converted state_dict

group_a_templates: a region of {class} viewed from above

strategy.visual_prototype: L2 normalize cached float32 development rows for each sam3_source_label, arithmetic mean, then L2 normalize each class prototype
strategy.text_prototype: L2 normalize each fixed Group A prompt embedding, arithmetic mean by class, then L2 normalize each class prototype
strategy.prediction_rule: argmax over the full 6-class vocabulary, no threshold
strategy.development_label_use: sam3_source_label only for one visual prototype per registered class

ground_truth.region_label_rule: majority vote of class-color pixels inside the SAM3 candidate mask cropped to the registered crop_box; background and ignore pixels never vote
ground_truth.unlabeled_rule: a heldout region with zero class-color pixels inside its mask is reported as unlabeled and excluded from metrics with its count disclosed
